answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Because an attacker cannot forge this scarcity, the economic cost of identity proliferation scales linearly with market value. Much like the slow erosion of a glacier carving a landscape, this process forces agents to commit long-term capital, ensuring that the influence of a malicious vine of sub-identities is stifled by the high barrier to entry.
